description: One tender from the signed-in company's 'Moje przetargi' by tender_id (from list_my_tenders or list_matched_tenders): pipeline status and its history, deadlines, the AI summary state (ready / requested / no_documents / none), the number of tender documents and archive files, the last document fill run, what filling in its documents still needs (fill_details: missing details, confirmed values, Janusz's price proposals), and links to its workspace in the app and its public page. The summary's text itself comes from get_tender with the returned slug. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.
name: get_my_tender
title: Mój przetarg
